ei.subject: 9월_2026 고1 모의고사
ei.lesson: Paul Farmer, Physician for the Poor

fullPassage: Paul Farmer was an American medical anthropologist and physician. He was born in 1959 in Massachusetts and grew up with an early awareness of social inequality. During his time at Duke University, he lived in Paris for half a year and became fluent in French, which benefited him in his future work in Haiti. After graduating from Duke University, he began volunteer work at a hospital in Cangé, Haiti. He later returned to the United States and earned both a master’s degree and a PhD in medical anthropology at Harvard University. In 1987, he co-founded Partners In Health, an organization that works in countries like Haiti, Rwanda, and Peru to provide medical treatment and strengthen public health systems. Throughout his life, he wrote more than ten books and over a hundred academic papers. He received many major awards during his career, and after his death, he was also honored with the WHO Director-General’s Global Health Leaders Award for his lifelong work to improve health for the poor.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: written → wrote: 주어 he의 본동사 자리이고 앞 문장들과 같은 과거 시제가 필요하므로 과거형 wrote가 맞다.
det.analysis:
① lived: he lived in Paris(과거동사) 적절
② returned: He later returned(과거동사) 적절
③ written → wrote: 주어 he의 본동사 자리, 앞뒤 문장과 같은 과거형 필요 ←정답
④ received: He received many awards(과거동사) 적절
det.tip: 주어 뒤 본동사 자리에는 과거분사(written)가 아니라 과거형(wrote)

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: While → During: 뒤에 「his time at Duke University」라는 명사구가 오므로 절을 이끄는 접속사가 아니라 전치사 During이 맞다.
